decisions.choice: two verbs for seeing, most likely for variety and because of the change of tense; both mean that the disciples will see Jesus
alternatives: the first verb means ordinary sight and the second a deeper seeing by faith
decisions.reason: The first "see" is θεωρεῖτέ (from θεωρέω), the second ὄψεσθέ, a future of ὁράω. The future of seeing was usually expressed with this second verb, so the change may simply follow the change of tense. John also uses the first verb for the disciples' seeing of Jesus after his death (14:19, "you see me"), so it does not stand only for bodily sight; and the second is used when the disciples see the risen Jesus (20:18, 20, 25, 29). Some readers find a contrast between seeing with the eyes and seeing with understanding, but John's usage does not clearly support it.

decisions.choice: the verse ends with "you will see me" (SBLGNT)
alternatives: adds "because I am going to the Father" (many later manuscripts)
decisions.reason: The oldest manuscripts, among them Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus, end the verse with "you will see me". Many later manuscripts add "because I am going to the Father", most likely taken from the disciples' question in verse 17, which joins this saying to the words of 16:10. A footnote gives the longer reading. A reviewer should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the two little whiles: first the short time until Jesus's death, then the short time until the disciples see him risen
alternatives: the second little while ends with the coming of the Spirit (14:16-19; 16:7)
the second little while ends with Jesus's return at the end of the age (14:3)
decisions.reason: Jesus is speaking on the night before his death, so the first little while is a matter of hours. The second ends when they see him again, and verses 20-22 describe that seeing as sorrow turned to joy; John tells it in those terms when the risen Jesus comes to them: "the disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord" (20:20). In 14:18-19 the same words about seeing him are tied to his coming to them and to the gift of the Spirit, and the promised joy and asking in his name (16:22-24) reach beyond Easter into the life of the church, so some take the second little while of the Spirit's coming or of his final return. The Easter reading fits the closest words best, but the others cannot be ruled out.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}
decisions.reason: Every pronoun for Christ or for God uses the deity_pronoun setting, including "me" and "my" when Jesus speaks of himself, "he" and "his" when the disciples or the narrator speak of him, and "he" for the Father. At the start of a sentence "He" or "My" is written plain. This applies throughout the passage.

decisions.choice: In a little while ... after another little while (B); In a little while ... a little while after that ... again (R); "will no longer see" in the future
alternatives: In a short time (as Balanced has in 14:19)
decisions.reason: In 14:19 Balanced and Readable say "in a short time" and "soon". Here they keep "a little while", because the disciples puzzle over that very phrase in verses 17-19 ("What is this 'little while'?"), and the same words must recur. The present "you no longer see" speaks of what is about to happen, so Balanced and Readable put it in the future, as in 14:19. Readable adds "again" to the second clause, which "again a little while" implies.

decisions.choice: Dentro de un poco ... después de otro poco (B); Dentro de un poco ... un poco después ... volverán a ver (R)
decisions.reason: At 14:19 Balanced and Readable say "dentro de poco" and "pronto". Here every level keeps "un poco", because the disciples puzzle over that very phrase in verses 17-19 and the same words must recur. The present "you no longer see" speaks of what is about to happen, so Balanced and Readable use the future. The speech that opened at 14:23 closes here, since narrative follows.

decisions.choice: un peu [de temps] (L); Dans peu de temps ... peu de temps après (B, R)
alternatives: Encore un peu de temps ... et encore un peu de temps
decisions.reason: French "un peu" alone does not name a stretch of time, so Literal brackets "de temps". Balanced and Readable put the first "little while" in the future, as the English does, and keep the words "peu de temps" at both points (meaning decision m3), because the disciples quote the saying in verses 17 and 19 and puzzle over "peu de temps" in verse 18; every level repeats its own wording there.

decisions.choice: muda mfupi at every level, repeated in verses 17-19; hamnitazami ... mtaniona (L)
decisions.reason: The disciples puzzle over this very phrase in verses 17-19, so each level repeats the same words each time. Literal brackets "muda", the noun Swahili needs for the Greek "a little". Literal keeps two verbs for the two Greek verbs of seeing (meaning note m1), "kutazama" as at 14:17 and 16:10, then "kuona". Here "me" is always the object marker "-ni-", so Swahili has no pronoun spans; in this passage the setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives (mimi, wake, langu), and one at the start of a sentence is written plain.

decisions.choice: Jesus says "Ta" for himself and "các con" to the disciples; they call him "Thầy"
decisions.reason: The forms of address set in the style guide for the whole book: Jesus speaks to his disciples as a teacher to those in his care. "Ta" mid-sentence is under the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean
alternatives: capitalised pronoun spans as in English
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change; respect is carried by the honorific -si-, 께서 and 그분 at every level (style guide section 7).

decisions.choice: 조금 [있으면] for mikron ("a little")
decisions.reason: Korean needs a verb to make "a little" a span of time; Literal brackets it, Balanced and Readable write it plainly.

decisions.choice: dentro de pouco tempo ... mais um pouco de tempo (B); pouco tempo (R)
decisions.reason: The disciples puzzle over this very phrase in verses 17-19, so Balanced and Readable use "pouco tempo" every time it occurs, and the disciples' question in verse 18 quotes it ("'pouco tempo'"). Literal keeps "um pouco [de tempo]".

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic in this passage
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the reader's setting for capitalised pronouns has nothing to change in Amharic. Pronouns for God, for Jesus and for the Spirit are written plainly throughout the passage.

decisions.choice: "ማየት" (to see) for both Greek verbs of seeing, in 16:16-19
alternatives: two different Amharic verbs, such as "መመልከት" (to look at) for the first
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m1 finds no difference of sense between the two verbs, so Amharic uses its one ordinary verb; the disciples' and Jesus's repetitions in verses 17 and 19 then read word for word as the saying they repeat.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi. Respect for Jesus and the Father is carried by the honorific third person ("वे ... कहते हैं", "पिता ... देंगे") and by the forms of address, at every level, through this passage.

decisions.choice: "थोड़ी देर"
decisions.reason: The saying is repeated word for word by the disciples (verse 17) and by Jesus (verse 19), so every level keeps one Hindi wording for it each time, as the English does; the disciples' puzzle in verse 18 is over "थोड़ी देर".

decisions.choice: "немного" (L); "ещё немного" (B, R), repeated word for word in verses 17-19
decisions.reason: The disciples quote this saying in verse 17 and puzzle over its "little while" in verse 18, and Jesus repeats it in verse 19 (meaning decisions m2-m3 there), so each level keeps one wording for it throughout.

decisions.choice: "少しの間" (L); "しばらく" (B); "もう少し" (R), repeated in the quotations of 16:17-19
decisions.reason: The disciples and then Jesus quote this saying word for word, and "a little while" is what puzzles them (16:18). Each level keeps one form of the phrase through verses 16-19 so the reader can see the repetition. Both verbs of seeing are "見る" (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "我", no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Chinese has no reverent first person, so Jesus's "I, me, my" takes no span where the English capitalises it, through this passage; "他" for Jesus and the Father takes the span.

decisions.choice: "再过一会儿……又过一会儿" (L); "再过不久……然后再过不久" (B); "很快……然后再过一会儿" (R)
decisions.reason: The saying is repeated by the disciples (16:17) and by Jesus (16:19); each level keeps one wording for it in all three places, with Literal's one changed word in 16:17 and 16:19.

decisions.choice: "تشاهدونني" ... "ترونني"
decisions.reason: The Greek uses two verbs for seeing, most likely for variety (m1). Literal keeps two Arabic verbs; Balanced and Readable use one, since both mean that the disciples will see Jesus.

decisions.choice: the verse ends with "you will see me"
alternatives: adding "because I am going to the Father"
decisions.reason: The text followed ends the verse with "you will see me" (m2); the words about going to the Father, which the disciples quote in verse 17, come from 16:10.

records.literal_gloss: Said therefore [some] of the disciples of him to one another, "What is this that he says to us, 'A little and not you see me, and again a little and you will see me';

en.B: Then some of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples said to one another, "What does {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} mean by telling us, 'In a little while you will no longer see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and then after another little while you will see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}'?
en.R: Some of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples began asking each other, "What does {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} mean by saying, 'In a little while you will not see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} anymore. Then a little while after that, you will see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} again'?

es.L: Dijeron entonces [algunos] de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos unos a otros: «¿Qué es esto que nos dice: “Un poco [de tiempo] y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:ven|veis}}, y de nuevo un poco [de tiempo] y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:verán|veréis}}”?
es.B: Entonces algunos de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos se dijeron unos a otros: «¿Qué quiere decir con eso de: “Dentro de un poco ya no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:verán|veréis}}; y después de otro poco, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:verán|veréis}}”?
es.R: Algunos de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos comenzaron a preguntarse entre ellos: «¿Qué quiere decir cuando dice: “Dentro de un poco ya no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:verán|veréis}}. Pero un poco después {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:volverán a ver|volveréis a ver}}”?

fr.L: [Certains] de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples se dirent donc les uns aux autres : « Qu’est-ce que cela, ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous dit : “Un peu [de temps] et vous ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} voyez pas, et de nouveau un peu [de temps] et vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} verrez” ?
fr.B: Alors quelques-uns de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples se dirent entre eux : « Que veut-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dire en nous disant : “Dans peu de temps, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} verrez plus, puis, peu de temps après, vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} verrez” ?
fr.R: Quelques-uns de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples ont commencé à se demander entre eux : « Que veut-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dire quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : “Dans peu de temps, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} verrez plus. Puis, peu de temps après, vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} reverrez” ?

vi.R: Vài môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắt đầu hỏi nhau: "Thầy muốn nói gì khi bảo: 'Chỉ ít lâu nữa thôi, các con sẽ không thấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nữa. Rồi ít lâu sau đó, các con sẽ lại thấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}'?

decisions.choice: some of his disciples, not all of them
decisions.reason: The phrase "out of his disciples" (ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν) has no word for "some"; the preposition itself marks a part of the group, as in 7:40. They speak "to one another", not to Jesus: they want to ask him but hold back (verse 19; compare 16:5).

decisions.choice: the disciples repeat Jesus's saying of verse 16 word for word, with one small change that does not alter its sense
decisions.reason: In verse 16 Jesus said "no longer" (οὐκέτι); the disciples, and Jesus himself in verse 19, say simply "not" (οὐ). The rest is the same. The saying is repeated three times in four verses (16, 17, 19), which shows how much it puzzled them and fixes it in the reader's mind.

decisions.choice: the disciples cannot yet understand that Jesus speaks of his death and resurrection
decisions.reason: John often notes that the disciples understood Jesus's words only after he rose (2:22; 12:16; 20:9). Here their question shows the same thing from the inside: they hear the words but cannot see what event they point to.

decisions.choice: the quotation repeats the wording of verse 16 at Balanced and Readable; Literal has "you do not see" for the one changed word
decisions.reason: The disciples quote what Jesus has just said, so Balanced and Readable repeat verse 16 exactly, as the reader will recognise it. Literal shows the one word that changes (meaning decision m2). Balanced and Readable turn "What is this that he says" into "What does he mean", the natural English for asking about the sense of words.

decisions.choice: historic present at Literal; pretérito at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in John: Literal keeps John's present where he tells past events in it; Balanced and Readable use the pretérito. This applies throughout the passage.

decisions.choice: the quotation repeats verse 16 at Balanced and Readable; Literal has "no me ven" for the one changed word
decisions.reason: The disciples quote what Jesus has just said, so Balanced and Readable repeat verse 16 exactly. Literal shows the one word that changes (meaning decision m2). "¿Qué quiere decir?" is the natural Spanish for asking about meaning.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B; "se dirent", "dit"), with the imperfect for what went on ("disaient"); passé composé (R; "ont commencé", "a dit"); speech in the passé composé at every level
alternatives: passé composé for narration at every level
decisions.reason: The French brief for the passage (16:16-24), as in 1:19. The passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative and suits a public reading; Readable uses the passé composé, the past tense French readers speak and learn first. Inside Jesus's words every level uses the passé composé ("j’ai dit", "vous n’avez rien demandé"). This passage has no historic present.

decisions.choice: the past at every level (walisema, wakaulizana)
decisions.reason: The narrative verbs of verses 17-19 are past tenses in Greek, so Literal tells in the past too; Balanced uses the narrative "-ka-" after "Ndipo", and Readable the plain past. Where John uses the historic present (verse 29), Literal keeps it. Literal has "hamnitazami" without "tena" for the one word the disciples change (meaning note m2).

decisions.choice: the disciples speak of Jesus among themselves as "Thầy"
decisions.reason: Talking among themselves, the disciples would not say "Ngài" of their teacher but "Thầy", the noun they use to address him; it is always capitalised and takes no setting. Literal keeps the historic present "Thầy nói" (he says) by leaving out "đã".

decisions.choice: The disciples speak among themselves in the plain style (해라체) and call Jesus 그분 (L) or 선생님 (B, R), with the honorific 말씀하시다
decisions.reason: Between equals the plain style is natural, but Jesus is still referred to with honour; 선생님 is how disciples would name their teacher in talk among themselves.
The disciples speak of Jesus among themselves with the honorific third person, as the narrator does; only his opponents and the crowd use plain forms (style guide section 7b).

decisions.choice: "не видите" (L) where verse 16 has "уже не видите"
decisions.reason: The disciples repeat the saying with one small change of word (meaning decision m2); Literal shows it, Balanced and Readable repeat verse 16, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "あの方" with "言っておられる" / "言われる" for Jesus in the disciples' talk among themselves
decisions.reason: Speaking among themselves, the disciples refer to Jesus with respect, as disciples would refer to their teacher; "あの方" also avoids "彼" for Jesus. They speak to one another in the plain style. Literal keeps "見ない" for the one changed word (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: Jesus's saying inside “ ” within the disciples' «»
alternatives: a colon with no inner marks
decisions.reason: The disciples repeat Jesus's saying of verse 16 word for word (m2), and they go on to quote a second saying. Inner marks show exactly where each quoted saying begins and ends. Each level repeats its own wording of verse 16; Literal has "ولا تشاهدونني" for the one small change (m2).

decisions.choice: "بعض تلاميذه"
decisions.reason: Some of his disciples, not all of them (m1).

decisions.choice: Ὅτι here means "because": the disciples quote Jesus's words of 16:10
alternatives: the word only introduces the quotation ("and, 'I am going to the Father'")
decisions.reason: This word often simply opens a quotation, and that is possible here. But 16:10 has the same words, "because I am going to the Father", and the disciples are putting together things Jesus has said in this discourse; they quote that phrase as he said it, reason word and all.

decisions.choice: going to the Father: Jesus's return to the Father through his death, resurrection and exaltation
decisions.reason: Jesus has spoken of his going to the Father again and again (13:1; 14:12, 28; 16:5, 10, 28). The disciples put this saying beside the one about the little while and cannot see how the two fit: how can he go away to the Father and also be seen again?

decisions.choice: And what about ... (B); And what does he mean, ... (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has only "and" before the second quoted saying; the question "What is this?" carries over from the first part. Balanced and Readable supply "what about" and "what does he mean" so that the second saying is plainly a second question.

decisions.choice: qué significa (B); qué quiere decir con (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: the Greek has only "and" before the second saying, and the question carries over from the first part. Balanced and Readable supply the words so that it is plainly a second question.

decisions.choice: "لأنّي"

decisions.choice: they were saying: they talked it over again and again
decisions.reason: The verb ἔλεγον is imperfect, the tense of continued or repeated action: the question went round among them.

decisions.choice: "little while" is what puzzles them most
decisions.reason: Of everything Jesus has said, they single out the phrase "a little while". They cannot tell what span of time he means, or what will happen at its end.

decisions.choice: kept saying (B); kept asking (R)
decisions.reason: "Kept saying" gives the sense of the continuing tense (meaning decision m1) in plain English. Readable says "asking", since what they say is a question.

decisions.choice: no dejaban de decir (B); seguían preguntándose (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: the continuing tense (meaning decision m1). Readable says "preguntarse", since what they say is a question.

decisions.choice: "ظلّوا يقولون" (B), "ظلّوا يسألون" (R)
decisions.reason: They were saying it again and again (m1); "ظلّ" with the present shows the repeated talk.

decisions.choice: we do not know what he is speaking of: they cannot grasp his meaning
decisions.reason: They have heard the words; what they lack is their meaning. "Know" (οἴδαμεν) here is understanding, as when Jesus says that his disciples did not understand his words until later (13:7). Jesus will soon speak to them plainly (16:25, 29).

decisions.choice: do not understand
decisions.reason: In English "we do not know what he is talking about" can sound dismissive; "understand" says that they are puzzled, which is the sense (meaning decision m1).

records.literal_gloss: Knew Jesus that they were wanting him to ask, and he said to them, "About this are you seeking with one another, that I said, 'A little and not you see me, and again a little and you will see me'?"

en.L: Jesus knew that they wanted to ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Are you inquiring with one another about this, that I said, 'A little [while] and you do not see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and again a little [while] and you will see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}'?
en.B: Jesus knew that they wanted to ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} about it, so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Are you discussing with one another what I meant when I said, 'In a little while you will no longer see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and then after another little while you will see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}'?
en.R: Jesus knew that they wanted to ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} about this. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Are you asking each other what I meant by these words: 'In a little while you will not see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} anymore. Then a little while after that, you will see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} again'?

es.L: Conoció Jesús que querían preguntarle, y les dijo: «¿Acerca de esto {{plural_you:indagan|indagáis}} entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, que dije: “Un poco [de tiempo] y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:ven|veis}}, y de nuevo un poco [de tiempo] y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:verán|veréis}}”?

Así que les dijo: «¿{{plural_you:Se están preguntando|Os estáis preguntando}} unos a otros qué quise decir con estas palabras: “Dentro de un poco ya no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:verán|veréis}}. Pero un poco después {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:volverán a ver|volveréis a ver}}”?

fr.R: Jésus savait qu’ils voulaient {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interroger là-dessus. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a dit : « Vous vous demandez entre vous ce que j’ai voulu dire par ces mots : “Dans peu de temps, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} verrez plus. Puis, peu de temps après, vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} reverrez” ?

Rồi ít lâu sau đó, các con sẽ lại thấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}'?

ko.B: 예수께서는 그들이 그것에 대해 묻고 싶어 한다는 것을 아시고 말씀하셨다. "내가 '조금 있으면 너희가 더 이상 나를 보지 못할 것이다. 그리고 다시 조금 더 있으면 나를 보게 될 것이다' 하고 말한 것이 무슨 뜻인지 너희가 서로 의논하고 있느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서는 제자들이 이것에 대해 묻고 싶어 한다는 것을 아셨다. 그래서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "내가 '조금 있으면 너희는 나를 더 이상 보지 못할 것이다. 그러나 그 뒤에 조금 더 있으면 다시 나를 보게 될 것이다' 하고 말한 것이 무슨 뜻인지 서로 묻고 있느냐?

Depois, pouco tempo mais tarde, vocês vão {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ver de novo'?

am.L: ኢየሱስም ሊጠይቁት እንደፈለጉ አወቀ፤ እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «“ጥቂት [ጊዜ ቆይቶ] አታዩኝም፤ ደግሞም ጥቂት [ጊዜ ቆይቶ] ታዩኛላችሁ” ስላልኩት ነገር እርስ በርሳችሁ ትመረምራላችሁን?

am.R: ኢየሱስ ስለዚህ ሊጠይቁት እንደፈለጉ አወቀ። ስለዚህ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «“በጥቂት ጊዜ ውስጥ ከእንግዲህ አታዩኝም። ከዚያ ጥቂት ጊዜ ቆይቶ እንደገና ታዩኛላችሁ” ስል ምን ማለቴ እንደሆነ እርስ በርሳችሁ ትጠያየቃላችሁ?

hi.L: यीशु ने जान लिया कि वे उनसे पूछना चाहते हैं, और उन्होंने उनसे कहा, "क्या तुम आपस में इस बारे में पूछताछ कर रहे हो कि मैंने कहा, 'थोड़ी देर, और तुम मुझे नहीं देखते, और फिर थोड़ी देर, और तुम मुझे देखोगे'?
hi.B: यीशु जान गए कि चेले उनसे इस बारे में पूछना चाहते हैं, इसलिए उन्होंने उनसे कहा, "क्या तुम आपस में इस पर चर्चा कर रहे हो कि मेरा क्या अर्थ था जब मैंने कहा, 'थोड़ी देर में तुम मुझे फिर नहीं देखोगे, और फिर थोड़ी देर बाद तुम मुझे देखोगे'?
hi.R: यीशु जान गए कि चेले उनसे इस बारे में पूछना चाहते हैं। इसलिए उन्होंने उनसे कहा, "क्या तुम एक-दूसरे से पूछ रहे हो कि इन शब्दों से मेरा क्या मतलब था: 'थोड़ी देर में तुम मुझे और नहीं देखोगे। फिर उसके थोड़ी देर बाद तुम मुझे फिर से देखोगे'?

ru.L: Иисус узнал, что они хотели спросить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, и сказал им: «Об этом ли вы спрашиваете друг друга, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сказал: “Немного — и вы не видите {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, и опять немного — и увидите {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}”?
ru.B: Иисус понял, что они хотят спросить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} об этом, и сказал им: «Вы обсуждаете между собой, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} имел в виду, когда сказал: “Ещё немного — и вы больше не увидите {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, а потом ещё немного — и вы увидите {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}”?
ru.R: Иисус понял, что они хотят спросить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} об этом. Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал им: «Вы спрашиваете друг друга, что значат эти {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} слова: “Ещё немного — и вы больше не будете видеть {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. А потом, ещё немного спустя, вы снова увидите {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}”?

uk.L: Ісус зрозумів, що вони хотіли запитати {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, і сказав їм: «Чи про це допитуєтеся між собою, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сказав: “Трохи — і не бачите {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, і знову трохи — і побачите {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}”?
uk.B: Ісус знав, що вони хочуть запитати {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} про це, тож сказав їм: «Ви обговорюєте між собою, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} мав на увазі, коли сказав: “Ще трохи, і ви вже не побачите {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, а потім ще трохи — і ви {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} побачите”?
uk.R: Ісус знав, що вони хочуть запитати {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} про це. Тож {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} сказав їм: «Ви питаєте один одного, що означають {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}} слова: “Незабаром ви більше не бачитимете {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}. А трохи згодом ви знову {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} побачите”?

ja.L: イエスは、彼らがイエスに尋ねたがっていることを知っておられた。そして彼らに言われた。「『少しの間[がたつ]と、あなたがたはわたしを見ない。そしてまた少しの間[がたつ]と、わたしを見るであろう』とわたしが言ったことについて、あなたがたは互いに論じ合っているのか？
ja.B: イエスは、弟子たちがそのことを尋ねたがっているのを知って、彼らに言われた。「『しばらくすると、あなたがたはもうわたしを見なくなる。しかし、またしばらくすると、わたしを見るようになる』とわたしが言ったのはどういう意味なのかと、互いに論じ合っているのか？
ja.R: イエスは、弟子たちがこのことを聞きたがっているのに気づいておられました。そこで、こう言われました。「『もう少しすると、あなたたちはもうわたしを見なくなる。でも、それからまた少しすると、わたしを見るようになる』というわたしの言葉はどういう意味なのかと、互いに聞き合っているのか？

id.L: Yesus tahu bahwa mereka ingin bertanya kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}, lalu {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} berkata kepada mereka, "Tentang inikah kalian saling bertanya, bahwa {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} berkata, 'Tinggal sesaat lagi dan kalian tidak melihat {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}}, dan tinggal sesaat lagi kalian akan melihat {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}}'?"
id.B: Yesus tahu bahwa mereka ingin bertanya kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} tentang hal itu, jadi {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} berkata kepada mereka, "Apakah kalian sedang membicarakan satu sama lain apa maksud-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} ketika {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} berkata, 'Tinggal sebentar lagi kalian tidak akan melihat {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} lagi, dan sebentar lagi sesudah itu kalian akan melihat {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}}'?
id.R: Yesus tahu bahwa mereka ingin bertanya kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} tentang hal itu. Jadi {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} berkata kepada mereka, "Apakah kalian saling bertanya apa maksud-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} dengan kata-kata ini: 'Tidak lama lagi kalian tidak akan melihat {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} lagi. Lalu tidak lama sesudah itu, kalian akan melihat {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} kembali'?

zh.L: 耶稣知道他们想要问{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}，就对他们说：“你们是在彼此探讨这件事，就是我说过‘再过一会儿，你们就看不见我；又过一会儿，你们还要看见我’吗？
zh.B: 耶稣知道他们想问{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}这件事，就对他们说：“我说‘再过不久，你们就看不见我了；然后再过不久，你们又会看见我’，你们是在彼此讨论这话是什么意思吗？
zh.R: 耶稣知道他们想问{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}这件事。于是{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}对他们说：“我说过‘很快你们就看不到我了。然后再过一会儿，你们又会看见我’，你们是在互相问这话的意思吗？

ar.L: وعرف يسوع أنّهم يريدون أن يسألوه، فقال لهم: «أتتباحثون فيما بينكم في هذا، أنّي قلت: “قليلًا ولا تشاهدونني، ثمّ قليلًا أيضًا فترونني”؟
ar.B: وعرف يسوع أنّهم يريدون أن يسألوه عن ذلك، فقال لهم: «أتتناقشون فيما بينكم في معنى قولي: “بعد وقت قصير لن تروني، ثمّ بعد وقت قصير آخر سترونني”؟
ar.R: وعرف يسوع أنّهم يريدون أن يسألوه عن هذا. فقال لهم: «هل تسألون بعضكم بعضًا عن معنى كلامي هذا: “بعد وقت قصير لن تروني بعد ذلك. ثمّ بعد وقت قصير آخر سترونني من جديد”؟

decisions.choice: Jesus knew: he was aware of their wish before they spoke; John does not say how
alternatives: he noticed it from their talk among themselves
decisions.reason: Jesus may simply have seen them talking together. But John often says that Jesus knew what was in people (2:24-25; 6:61, 64; 13:11), and a few verses later the disciples say, "Now we know that you know all things and do not need anyone to question you" (16:30), which answers this very moment. John most likely means more than ordinary noticing, though the words alone do not say so.

decisions.choice: ask him: put a question to him; seeking with one another: discussing among themselves
decisions.reason: The verb for "ask" (ἐρωτᾶν, from ἐρωτάω) is the one for asking a question, and it returns in verse 23: "in that day you will ask me nothing". The verb ζητεῖτε means seeking, here seeking an answer together, talking it over.

decisions.choice: Jesus repeats his saying in the same words as the disciples did
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes himself with "not" instead of "no longer", exactly as the disciples did in verse 17. He does not explain the riddle directly; he answers with what the little whiles will bring: sorrow and then joy (verses 20-22).

decisions.choice: discussing with one another what I meant when I said (B); asking each other what I meant by these words (R); the quoted saying as in verse 16
alternatives: inquiring with one another about this, that I said (Literal)
decisions.reason: "About this ... that I said" is a Greek way of pointing to the words in question; Balanced says "what I meant when I said", Readable "what I meant by these words". The quoted saying is worded as in verse 16 so that readers recognise it.

decisions.choice: qué quise decir cuando dije (B); qué quise decir con estas palabras (R); the saying as in verse 16
decisions.reason: As in English: "about this ... that I said" points to the words in question (meaning decision m2), and the saying is worded as in verse 16 so that readers recognise it. The speech that opens here runs on to verse 28, so it closes there; Spanish does not reopen the quotation at the paragraph break of verse 25.
Beside the honorific "वे" for Jesus, a plain "वे" for the disciples would leave the sentence unclear, so Balanced and Readable name them.

decisions.choice: the saying repeated in “ ” with the same wording as in verse 17
decisions.reason: Jesus repeats his saying in the same words as the disciples did (m3), so each level repeats its own wording of verse 17.

decisions.choice: "تتباحثون" (L), "تتناقشون" (B), "تسألون بعضكم بعضًا" (R)
decisions.reason: Seeking with one another means discussing among themselves (m2).

source.text: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι κλαύσετε καὶ θρηνήσετε ὑμεῖς, ὁ δὲ κόσμος χαρήσεται· ὑμεῖς λυπηθήσεσθε, ἀλλ’ ἡ λύπη ὑμῶν εἰς χαρὰν γενήσεται.

records.literal_gloss: Truly truly I say to you that will weep and will lament you, the but world will rejoice; you will be grieved, but the grief of you into joy will become.

en.L: Truly, truly I say to you, you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice; you will be made sorrowful, but your sorrow will turn into joy.
en.B: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and mourn aloud, but the world will rejoice. You will be full of sorrow, but your sorrow will become joy.
en.R: I tell you the truth: you will cry and mourn, but the world will be glad. You will be very sad, but your sadness will turn into joy.

es.L: En verdad, en verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que {{plural_you:ustedes llorarán y harán duelo|vosotros lloraréis y haréis duelo}}, pero el mundo se regocijará; {{plural_you:ustedes serán entristecidos|vosotros seréis entristecidos}}, pero {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tristeza se volverá gozo.
es.B: En verdad, en verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que {{plural_you:llorarán y se lamentarán|lloraréis y os lamentaréis}} a gritos, mientras el mundo se alegra. {{plural_you:Estarán|Estaréis}} llenos de tristeza, pero {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tristeza se transformará en gozo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: {{plural_you:llorarán y estarán de luto|lloraréis y estaréis de luto}}, pero el mundo estará contento. {{plural_you:Estarán muy tristes|Estaréis muy tristes}}, pero {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tristeza se volverá gozo.

fr.L: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, vous pleurerez et vous vous lamenterez, vous, mais le monde se réjouira ; vous serez peinés, mais votre peine deviendra joie.
fr.B: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis : vous pleurerez et vous vous lamenterez à grands cris, mais le monde se réjouira. Vous serez dans la peine, mais votre peine se transformera en joie.
fr.R: Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : vous allez pleurer et vous lamenter, mais le monde, lui, se réjouira. Vous serez très tristes, mais votre tristesse se transformera en joie.

sw.L: Kweli kweli nawaambia, ninyi mtalia na kuomboleza, lakini ulimwengu utafurahi; ninyi mtahuzunishwa, lakini huzuni yenu itageuka kuwa furaha.
sw.B: Kweli kweli nawaambia, mtalia na kuomboleza kwa sauti, lakini ulimwengu utafurahi. Mtajawa na huzuni, lakini huzuni yenu itakuwa furaha.
sw.R: Nawaambia ukweli: mtalia na kuomboleza, lakini ulimwengu utafurahi. Mtahuzunika sana, lakini huzuni yenu itageuka kuwa furaha.

vi.L: Thật vậy, thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con: các con sẽ khóc và than khóc, còn thế gian sẽ vui mừng; các con sẽ phải buồn rầu, nhưng nỗi buồn của các con sẽ trở thành niềm vui.
vi.B: Thật vậy, thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, các con sẽ khóc lóc và than khóc lớn tiếng, còn thế gian thì vui mừng. Các con sẽ đầy buồn rầu, nhưng nỗi buồn của các con sẽ biến thành niềm vui.
vi.R: Ta nói thật với các con: các con sẽ khóc than, còn thế gian thì vui. Các con sẽ rất buồn, nhưng nỗi buồn ấy sẽ biến thành niềm vui.

ko.L: 진실로 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희는 울며 애곡할 것이나 세상은 기뻐할 것이다. 너희는 슬픔에 잠기겠지만, 너희의 슬픔이 기쁨으로 변할 것이다.
ko.B: 진실로 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희는 울며 통곡하겠지만 세상은 기뻐할 것이다. 너희는 슬픔에 잠기겠지만, 너희의 슬픔은 기쁨이 될 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 분명히 말한다. 너희는 울며 슬퍼할 것이다. 그러나 세상은 기뻐할 것이다. 너희는 몹시 슬프겠지만, 그 슬픔이 기쁨으로 바뀔 것이다.

pt.L: Em verdade, em verdade eu lhes digo que vocês chorarão e se lamentarão, mas o mundo se alegrará; vocês ficarão tristes, mas a tristeza de vocês se transformará em alegria.
pt.B: Em verdade, em verdade eu lhes digo: vocês chorarão e se lamentarão em alta voz, mas o mundo se alegrará. Vocês se encherão de tristeza, mas a tristeza de vocês se tornará alegria.
pt.R: Eu garanto a vocês: vocês vão chorar e ficar de luto, mas o mundo vai ficar contente. Vocês vão ficar muito tristes, mas a tristeza de vocês vai se transformar em alegria.

am.L: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፣ እናንተ ታለቅሳላችሁ፤ ሙሾም ታወርዳላችሁ፤ ዓለም ግን ደስ ይለዋል፤ እናንተ ታዝናላችሁ፤ ነገር ግን ሐዘናችሁ ወደ ደስታ ይለወጣል።
am.B: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፣ ታለቅሳላችሁ፤ ሙሾም ታወርዳላችሁ፤ ዓለም ግን ይደሰታል። እናንተ በሐዘን ትሞላላችሁ፤ ሐዘናችሁ ግን ደስታ ይሆናል።
am.R: እውነቱን እነግራችኋለሁ፤ ታለቅሳላችሁ፤ ታዝናላችሁም፤ ዓለም ግን ደስ ይለዋል። እጅግ ታዝናላችሁ፤ ነገር ግን ሐዘናችሁ ወደ ደስታ ይለወጣል።

hi.L: मैं तुमसे सच सच कहता हूँ कि तुम रोओगे और विलाप करोगे, पर संसार आनंद करेगा; तुम्हें शोक होगा, पर तुम्हारा शोक आनंद में बदल जाएगा।
hi.B: मैं तुमसे सच सच कहता हूँ, तुम रोओगे और ऊँचे स्वर से विलाप करोगे, पर संसार आनंद मनाएगा। तुम शोक से भर जाओगे, पर तुम्हारा शोक आनंद बन जाएगा।
hi.R: मैं तुमसे सच सच कहता हूँ: तुम रोओगे और मातम करोगे, पर संसार ख़ुश होगा। तुम बहुत दुखी होगे, पर तुम्हारा दुख आनंद में बदल जाएगा।

ru.L: Истинно, истинно говорю вам: вы будете плакать и рыдать, а мир будет радоваться; вы будете опечалены, но ваша печаль обратится в радость.
ru.B: Истинно, истинно говорю вам: вы будете плакать и громко скорбеть, а мир будет радоваться. Вы будете полны печали, но ваша печаль станет радостью.
ru.R: Говорю вам правду: вы будете плакать и горевать, а мир будет радоваться. Вам будет очень грустно, но ваша грусть превратится в радость.

uk.L: Істинно, істинно кажу вам, що ви заплачете і заголосите, а світ радітиме; ви засмутитеся, але ваш смуток обернеться на радість.
uk.B: Істинно, істинно кажу вам: ви плакатимете й голоситимете, а світ радітиме. Ви будете сповнені смутку, але ваш смуток стане радістю.
uk.R: Кажу вам правду: ви плакатимете й сумуватимете, а світ радітиме. Вам буде дуже сумно, але ваш сум обернеться на радість.

ja.L: アーメン、アーメン、あなたがたに言う。あなたがたは泣き、嘆き悲しむが、世は喜ぶであろう。あなたがたは悲しまされるが、あなたがたの悲しみは喜びとなるであろう。
ja.B: まことに、まことに、あなたがたに言っておく。あなたがたは泣き、声をあげて嘆くが、世は喜ぶ。あなたがたは悲しみに沈むが、その悲しみは喜びに変わる。
ja.R: 本当のことを言おう。あなたたちは泣いて悲しむが、この世は喜ぶ。あなたたちはとても悲しくなる。でも、その悲しみは喜びに変わるのだ。

id.L: Amin, amin, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} berkata kepada kalian, kalian akan menangis dan meratap, tetapi dunia akan bersukacita; kalian akan berdukacita, tetapi dukacita kalian akan berubah menjadi sukacita.
id.B: Sesungguhnya, sesungguhnya {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} berkata kepada kalian, kalian akan menangis dan meratap dengan keras, tetapi dunia akan bersukacita. Kalian akan berdukacita, tetapi dukacita kalian akan berubah menjadi sukacita.
id.R: Aku mengatakan yang sebenarnya kepada kalian: kalian akan menangis dan meratap, tetapi dunia akan bergembira. Kalian akan sangat sedih, tetapi kesedihan kalian akan berubah menjadi sukacita.

zh.L: 阿们，阿们，我告诉你们，你们将要哭泣、哀号，世界却要欢喜；你们会被忧愁充满，但你们的忧愁将会转为喜乐。
zh.B: 我确确实实地告诉你们，你们会哭泣，会放声哀哭，世界却会欢喜。你们会满心忧愁，但你们的忧愁要化为喜乐。
zh.R: 我把实话告诉你们，你们会哭，会伤心痛哭，世界却会高兴。你们会非常难过，但你们的难过会变成喜悦。

ar.L: آمين آمين أقول لكم: ستبكون أنتم وتندبون، والعالم سيفرح؛ ستحزنون، لكنّ حزنكم سيصير فرحًا.
ar.B: الحقّ الحقّ أقول لكم: ستبكون وتنوحون بصوت عالٍ، أمّا العالم ففرحان. ستمتلئون حزنًا، لكنّ حزنكم سيتحوّل إلى فرح.
ar.R: أقول لكم الحقّ: ستبكون وتنوحون، أمّا العالم فسيكون مسرورًا. ستحزنون كثيرًا، لكنّ حزنكم سينقلب فرحًا.

decisions.choice: weep and lament: loud mourning, the kind made for the dead
decisions.reason: "Weep" (κλαύσετε) is crying aloud, as Mary and the mourners wept for Lazarus (11:31, 33). "Lament" (θρηνήσετε) is the wailing of a funeral; Luke uses it of the women who mourned for Jesus on the way to the cross (Luke 23:27). Jesus is telling them that they will mourn him as one who has died.

decisions.choice: the world: humanity set against Jesus, which will be glad at his death
decisions.reason: As in 15:18-19, the world is set against the disciples: those who hate Jesus and want him gone. The stressed "you" and "the world" are put side by side: the same event will bring grief to one and gladness to the other.

decisions.choice: your sorrow will become joy: the same events that cause their grief will become the cause of their joy
alternatives: their sorrow will be replaced by joy
decisions.reason: The Greek says that the sorrow itself "will become" joy, not that joy will come after it. The death they mourn, once he is risen, becomes the ground of their joy. Verse 21 gives a picture of exactly this: the pain of childbirth issues in the joy of a new life.

decisions.choice: Truly, truly I say to you (L); Truly, truly, I tell you (B); I tell you the truth (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering for John (see 1:51), recorded once in this passage; it applies also in verse 23.

decisions.choice: weep and lament (L); weep and mourn aloud (B); cry and mourn (R); sorrow (L, B) and sadness (R) for the noun throughout verses 20-22
decisions.reason: Balanced says "mourn aloud" for the loud lament of mourners (meaning decision m1). The noun for sorrow occurs in verses 20, 21 and 22, and the link between them is the point of the picture, so Literal and Balanced say "sorrow" each time and Readable says "sad" or "sadness" in verses 20 and 22.

decisions.choice: En verdad, en verdad les digo (L, B); Les digo la verdad (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering for John in Spanish (see 1:51), recorded once in this passage; it applies also in verse 23.

decisions.choice: harán duelo (L); se lamentarán a gritos (B); estarán de luto (R); tristeza for the noun throughout verses 20-22; gozo at every level
decisions.reason: The second verb is the loud lament of mourners (meaning decision m1). The noun for sorrow occurs in verses 20, 21 and 22, and the link between them is the point of the picture, so every level says "tristeza" in verses 20 and 22. "Gozo" is the word of 15:11.

decisions.choice: En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis (L, B); Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité (R)
alternatives: Amen, amen, je vous le dis
Oui, vraiment, je vous le dis
decisions.reason: The book-wide French rendering for John, recorded once in this passage (16:20, 23). Readable puts the pledge in plain words.

decisions.choice: peinés, la peine (L, B); tristes, la tristesse (R), and "souffrir", "la douleur" for the woman in labour (R, verse 21)
decisions.reason: The same noun runs through verses 20-22, for the disciples' grief and for the pain of labour (verse 21, meaning decision m1 there). French "la peine" covers both grief and hardship, so Literal and Balanced can keep one word for both, where "tristesse" would sound odd for a woman giving birth. Readable uses the plainest word in each place, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Kweli kweli nawaambia (L, B); Nawaambia ukweli (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering of the double amen (see 1:51), recorded once in this passage; the same in verse 23.

decisions.choice: kuomboleza (lament); huzuni for the noun in verses 20 and 22 at every level
decisions.reason: "Kuomboleza" is the mourning made for the dead (meaning note m1); Balanced adds "kwa sauti" (aloud), as the English does. Swahili "huzuni" is plain enough for Readable, so all three levels keep one word for the sorrow that turns into joy, which is the point of the picture.

decisions.choice: Thật vậy, thật vậy, Ta nói với các con (L, B); Ta nói thật với các con (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's rendering of the double "amen" for the whole book, recorded once in this passage. "Quả thật" is the familiar 1926 wording, avoided so as not to drift toward it.

decisions.choice: 진실로 진실로 너희에게 말한다 (L, B); 내가 분명히 말한다 (R)
decisions.reason: The guide's book-wide rendering of amen amen (one decision for the passage).

decisions.choice: 울며 애곡하다 (L); 울며 통곡하다 (B); 울며 슬퍼하다 (R)
decisions.reason: The second verb is loud mourning for the dead; 애곡 and 통곡 say that, Readable uses the common word.

decisions.choice: tristeza, ficar triste (L, B, R) for the noun and verb in verses 20 and 22
decisions.reason: The noun for sorrow ties verses 20-22 together, so "tristeza" is kept for the disciples' grief at every level. In verse 21, where it is a woman's pain in labour, Balanced and Readable say "dor", which in Portuguese covers both bodily pain and grief.

decisions.choice: "እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ" (L, B); "እውነቱን እነግራችኋለሁ" (R), also in 16:23
decisions.reason: John's doubled amēn is the book's fixed formula at Literal and Balanced; Readable says plainly "I tell you the truth".

decisions.choice: "ሙሾ ታወርዳላችሁ" (you will sing laments)
decisions.reason: "ሙሾ ማውረድ" is the Ethiopian lament sung for the dead, the kind of loud mourning the verb means (meaning decision m1); Readable says simply "you will grieve".

decisions.choice: "मैं तुमसे सच सच कहता हूँ" at every level
decisions.reason: The doubled "amen" of John is "मैं तुमसे सच सच कहता हूँ" at every level (docs/john-terms.md); the same in verse 23.
The same noun names the disciples' sorrow and the woman's in verse 21 (meaning decision m1 there), so one Hindi word is kept for it through verses 20-22 at each level.

decisions.choice: "Истинно, истинно говорю вам" (L, B); "Говорю вам правду" (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering of the double "amen" in John, recorded once in this passage; it covers verse 23 as well.

decisions.choice: "печаль" (L, B); "грусть" (R), the same noun through verses 20-22
decisions.reason: The same Greek noun is used for the disciples' grief and the pain of labour (verse 21); Literal and Balanced keep "печаль" throughout so that the link stays visible, as the English keeps "sorrow".

decisions.choice: "Істинно, істинно кажу вам" (L, B); "Кажу вам правду" (R), also in verse 23
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering of the double amen: Literal and Balanced keep the solemn formula; Readable says plainly that what follows is true.

decisions.choice: "アーメン、アーメン、あなたがたに言う" (L); "まことに、まことに、あなたがたに言っておく" (B); "本当のことを言おう" (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide forms for John's doubled amen, recorded once in this passage; they apply also in 16:23. "悲しみ" is kept for the noun through verses 20-22 at Literal and Balanced, so that the link with the woman's sorrow (16:21) stays visible.

decisions.choice: "阿们，阿们，我告诉你们" (L); "我确确实实地告诉你们" (B); "我把实话告诉你们" (R)
decisions.reason: John's doubled "amen" is kept doubled at Literal and shown by the doubled "确确实实" at Balanced, kept apart from the Synoptic single "amen"; Readable says it plainly. Also 16:23.

decisions.choice: "忧愁……喜乐" (L, B); "难过……喜悦" (R)
decisions.reason: One noun for sorrow and one for joy through verses 20-24 at each level, so the turn from one to the other is heard; Readable uses the everyday words.

decisions.choice: "تبكون وتندبون" (L), "تبكون وتنوحون بصوت عالٍ" (B), "تبكون وتنوحون" (R)
decisions.reason: Weeping and lamenting is loud mourning, the kind made for the dead (m1). "ندب" and "ناح" are the Arabic words for wailing over the dead.

decisions.choice: "سيصير فرحًا" (L), "سيتحوّل إلى فرح" (B), "سينقلب فرحًا" (R)
decisions.reason: The same events that cause their grief will become the cause of their joy (m3): the sorrow itself turns into joy, not merely gives way to it.

source.text: ἡ γυνὴ ὅταν τίκτῃ λύπην ἔχει, ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα αὐτῆς· ὅταν δὲ γεννήσῃ τὸ παιδίον, οὐκέτι μνημονεύει τῆς θλίψεως διὰ τὴν χαρὰν ὅτι ἐγεννήθη ἄνθρωπος εἰς τὸν κόσμον.

records.literal_gloss: The woman when she gives birth sorrow has, because came the hour of her; when but she has borne the child, no longer she remembers the affliction because of the joy that was born a human being into the world.

en.L: The woman, when she is giving birth, has sorrow, because her hour has come; but when she has given birth to the child, she no longer remembers the anguish, because of the joy that a human being has been born into the world.
en.B: When a woman is giving birth she has sorrow, because her hour has come. But once her child is born, she no longer remembers the anguish, for joy that a human being has been born into the world.
en.R: When a woman is having a baby, she is in pain, because her time has come. But after the baby is born, she forgets all that pain. She is full of joy that a new person has come into the world.

es.L: La mujer, cuando está dando a luz, tiene tristeza, porque vino su hora; pero cuando ha dado a luz a la criatura, ya no recuerda la aflicción, a causa del gozo de que un ser humano nació en el mundo.
es.B: Cuando una mujer está dando a luz, siente tristeza, porque ha llegado su hora. Pero, una vez que nace la criatura, ya no recuerda la aflicción, por el gozo de que un ser humano haya venido al mundo.
es.R: Cuando una mujer va a tener un bebé, siente dolor, porque le ha llegado la hora. Pero después de que nace el bebé, se olvida de todo ese dolor. Está llena de gozo porque ha llegado al mundo una nueva persona.

fr.L: La femme, lorsqu’elle enfante, a de la peine, parce que son heure est venue ; mais lorsqu’elle a mis au monde l’enfant, elle ne se souvient plus de la détresse, à cause de la joie de ce qu’un être humain est né dans le monde.
fr.B: Quand une femme accouche, elle est dans la peine, parce que son heure est venue. Mais une fois l’enfant né, elle ne se souvient plus de ses souffrances, tant elle a de joie qu’un être humain soit venu au monde.
fr.R: Quand une femme met un bébé au monde, elle souffre, parce que le moment est venu. Mais quand le bébé est né, elle oublie toute sa douleur. Elle est pleine de joie parce qu’un nouvel être humain est venu au monde.

sw.L: Mwanamke anapojifungua huwa na huzuni, kwa sababu saa yake imewadia; lakini anapokwisha kumzaa mtoto, hayakumbuki tena mateso yale, kwa sababu ya furaha kwamba binadamu amezaliwa katika ulimwengu.
sw.B: Mwanamke anapojifungua huwa na huzuni, kwa sababu saa yake imewadia. Lakini mtoto wake akishazaliwa, hayakumbuki tena mateso yake, kwa furaha ya kwamba binadamu amezaliwa ulimwenguni.
sw.R: Mwanamke anapozaa mtoto huwa na uchungu, kwa sababu wakati wake umefika. Lakini mtoto akishazaliwa, anasahau uchungu wote ule. Anajawa na furaha kwamba mtu mpya amekuja ulimwenguni.

vi.L: Người phụ nữ khi sinh con thì đau buồn, vì giờ của mình đã đến; nhưng khi đã sinh đứa con rồi, thì không còn nhớ đến cơn khổ đau nữa, vì niềm vui rằng một con người đã được sinh ra trong thế gian.
vi.B: Người phụ nữ khi sinh con thì đau buồn, vì giờ của mình đã đến. Nhưng khi đứa con đã ra đời, người ấy không còn nhớ đến cơn khổ đau nữa, vì vui mừng rằng một con người đã chào đời trong thế gian.
vi.R: Khi một người phụ nữ sinh con, chị ấy phải chịu đau đớn, vì đã đến lúc sinh. Nhưng khi em bé chào đời, chị quên hết cơn đau. Chị vui mừng vì một con người mới đã ra đời trong thế gian.

ko.L: 여자가 해산할 때에는 자기의 때가 왔으므로 괴로움을 겪는다. 그러나 아이를 낳으면, 한 사람이 세상에 태어났다는 기쁨 때문에 그 고통을 더 이상 기억하지 않는다.
ko.B: 여자가 아이를 낳을 때에는 해산할 때가 왔으므로 괴로움을 겪는다. 그러나 아이를 낳고 나면, 한 사람이 세상에 태어났다는 기쁨 때문에 그 고통을 더 이상 기억하지 않는다.
ko.R: 여자가 아기를 낳을 때에는 그때가 되었기 때문에 몹시 아프다. 그러나 아기가 태어나면 그 아픔을 다 잊어버린다. 새 사람이 세상에 태어났다는 기쁨이 가득하기 때문이다.

pt.L: A mulher, quando está dando à luz, tem tristeza, porque chegou a sua hora; mas, quando dá à luz a criança, já não se lembra da aflição, por causa da alegria de que um ser humano veio ao mundo.
pt.B: Quando uma mulher está dando à luz, sente dor, porque chegou a sua hora. Mas, depois que a criança nasce, ela já não se lembra da aflição, pela alegria de que um ser humano veio ao mundo.
pt.R: Quando uma mulher vai ter um bebê, ela sente dor, porque chegou a hora dela. Mas, depois que o bebê nasce, ela esquece toda aquela dor. Ela fica cheia de alegria porque uma nova pessoa veio ao mundo.

am.L: ሴት ስትወልድ ሰዓቷ ስለ ደረሰ ሐዘን አለባት፤ ሕፃኑን በወለደች ጊዜ ግን ሰው ወደ ዓለም ስለ ተወለደ ከደስታዋ የተነሣ ጭንቀቱን ከእንግዲህ አታስታውስም።
am.B: ሴት በምትወልድበት ጊዜ ሰዓቷ ስለ ደረሰ ታዝናለች። ልጁን ከወለደች በኋላ ግን አንድ ሰው ወደ ዓለም በመወለዱ ደስ ስለሚላት ጭንቀቱን ከእንግዲህ አታስታውሰውም።
am.R: አንዲት ሴት ልጅ ልትወልድ ስትል ጊዜዋ ስለ ደረሰ ትሠቃያለች። ልጁ ከተወለደ በኋላ ግን ያን ሁሉ ሥቃይ ትረሳዋለች። አዲስ ሰው ወደ ዓለም በመምጣቱ በደስታ ትሞላለች።

hi.L: स्त्री को जब वह जनती है, शोक होता है, क्योंकि उसकी घड़ी आ पहुँची है; पर जब वह बच्चे को जन्म दे चुकती है, तो इस आनंद के कारण कि संसार में एक मनुष्य उत्पन्न हुआ, उस पीड़ा को फिर याद नहीं करती।
hi.B: जब कोई स्त्री बच्चे को जन्म देने लगती है, तो उसे शोक होता है, क्योंकि उसकी घड़ी आ पहुँची है। पर जब बच्चा पैदा हो जाता है, तो वह उस पीड़ा को फिर याद नहीं करती, इस आनंद के कारण कि संसार में एक मनुष्य जन्मा है।
hi.R: जब किसी स्त्री को बच्चा होनेवाला होता है, तो उसे दर्द होता है, क्योंकि उसका समय आ गया है। पर बच्चा पैदा होने के बाद वह सारा दर्द भूल जाती है। वह आनंद से भर जाती है कि संसार में एक नया इंसान आया है।

ru.L: Женщина, когда рожает, имеет печаль, потому что пришёл её час; а когда родит ребёнка, уже не помнит мучений от радости, что родился человек в мир.
ru.B: Когда женщина рожает, у неё печаль, потому что пришёл её час. Но когда ребёнок родился, она уже не помнит мучений от радости, что в мир родился человек.
ru.R: Когда женщина рожает, ей больно, потому что пришло её время. Но когда ребёнок родится, она забывает всю эту боль. Она полна радости оттого, что в мир пришёл новый человек.

uk.L: Жінка, коли народжує, має смуток, бо прийшла її година; а коли народить дитину, вже не памʼятає муки з радості, що людина народилася на світ.
uk.B: Жінка, коли народжує, сумує, бо настала її година. Але щойно дитина народиться, вона вже не памʼятає муки, бо радіє, що на світ народилася людина.
uk.R: Коли жінка народжує, їй боляче, бо настав її час. Але коли дитина народиться, вона забуває весь той біль. Вона сповнена радості, що у світ прийшла нова людина.

ja.L: 女は子を産むとき、悲しみを持つ。自分の時が来たからである。しかし、子を産んでしまうと、一人の人間が世に生まれた喜びのために、もはやその苦しみを思い出さない。
ja.B: 女性は子どもを産むとき、悲しみを味わう。自分の時が来たからである。しかし、子どもが生まれると、一人の人間が世に生まれ出た喜びのために、もうその苦しみを思い出さない。
ja.R: 女の人は赤ちゃんを産むとき、苦しむ。その時が来たからだ。でも、赤ちゃんが生まれると、その苦しみをすっかり忘れてしまう。新しい人がこの世に生まれた喜びで、いっぱいになるからだ。

id.L: Perempuan yang melahirkan berdukacita, karena saatnya telah tiba; tetapi setelah ia melahirkan anaknya, ia tidak ingat lagi akan penderitaannya, karena sukacita bahwa seorang manusia telah dilahirkan ke dunia.
id.B: Seorang perempuan yang sedang melahirkan merasa sedih, karena saatnya telah tiba. Tetapi setelah anaknya lahir, ia tidak ingat lagi akan penderitaannya, karena sukacita bahwa seorang manusia telah lahir ke dunia.
id.R: Seorang ibu yang sedang melahirkan merasa sakit, karena waktunya sudah tiba. Tetapi setelah bayinya lahir, ia lupa akan semua rasa sakit itu. Dia penuh sukacita karena seorang manusia baru telah lahir ke dunia.

zh.L: 那妇人分娩的时候会有忧愁，因为她的时刻来到了；但当她生下了孩子，因着有一个人出生到世界上来的喜乐，她就不再记得那痛苦了。
zh.B: 妇女在分娩的时候会忧愁，因为她的时刻到了。可是孩子一出生，她就因为有一个人诞生到世上来而满心喜乐，不再记得那痛苦了。
zh.R: 一个女人要生孩子的时候，会很痛苦，因为她的时候到了。可是孩子出生以后，她就忘记了所有的痛苦。她满心喜悦，因为一个新的生命来到了世上。

ar.L: المرأة حين تلد يصيبها الحزن، لأنّ ساعتها حانت؛ فإذا ولدت الطفل، لم تعد تذكر الضيق، من فرحها بأنّ إنسانًا وُلد في العالم.
ar.B: حين تلد المرأة تحزن، لأنّ ساعتها قد أتت. لكن متى وُلد طفلها، لا تعود تذكر الشدّة، من فرحتها بأنّ إنسانًا قد وُلد في العالم.
ar.R: عندما تلد المرأة تتألّم، لأنّ وقتها قد جاء. لكن بعد أن يولد الطفل تنسى كلّ ذلك الألم. فهي مملوءة فرحًا لأنّ إنسانًا جديدًا جاء إلى العالم.

decisions.choice: sorrow: the pain and distress of labor, called by the same word as the disciples' sorrow
decisions.reason: The noun λύπην usually means grief, but it is also used of bodily pain, and here it covers both. Jesus uses the same word for the disciples in verses 20 and 22, so that the woman's labor is a picture of their grief.

decisions.choice: her hour: the time for her child to be born
alternatives: a deliberate echo of Jesus's own hour
decisions.reason: In the picture, "her hour" is simply the time of giving birth. Yet "the hour" is John's word for the time of Jesus's death and glory (12:23, 27; 13:1; 17:1), and the woman's hour stands for the disciples' hour of grief at that death. The plain sense is certain; how far John means the echo is not.

decisions.choice: ἄνθρωπος: a human being, a new person
decisions.reason: The word is the general word for a human being, not the word for a male. The point is not the child's sex but that a new human life has come into the world, which outweighs the pain.

decisions.choice: the pains of childbirth: a picture the prophets used for the distress that comes before God's new age
alternatives: an everyday picture with no particular passage in view
decisions.reason: The prophets compare Israel's suffering before God saves it to a woman in labor (Isaiah 26:17-19, where the picture ends in the dead rising; 66:7-14; Micah 4:9-10). Isaiah 66 also gives the words Jesus uses in verse 22 (66:14, "you will see, and your heart will rejoice"). The picture works on its own as everyday life; that John wants readers to hear the prophets as well is likely but not certain.

decisions.choice: sorrow (L, B), pain (R); anguish (L, B), all that pain (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "sorrow" for the same noun as in verses 20 and 22, so the link stays visible (meaning decision m1). Readable says "pain", which a young reader expects of childbirth. For the second noun, a word for pressure and distress, Literal and Balanced say "anguish".

decisions.choice: a woman (B, R); her hour (L, B), her time (R); a human being (L, B), a new person (R)
decisions.reason: The article with "woman" marks the general case, so Balanced and Readable say "a woman". Literal and Balanced keep "her hour" so that the echo of Jesus's hour can be heard (meaning decision m2); Readable says "her time". "A human being" is already inclusive, so no setting is needed; "a man" would suggest a male child, which the word does not mean (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: tristeza (L, B), dolor (R); aflicción (L, B), todo ese dolor (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: Literal and Balanced keep "tristeza" for the same noun as in verses 20 and 22, so the link stays visible (meaning decision m1); Readable says "dolor", which a young reader expects of childbirth.

decisions.choice: su hora (L, B); le ha llegado la hora (R); la criatura (L, B), el bebé (R); un ser humano (L, B), una nueva persona (R)
decisions.reason: Every level keeps "hora", so the echo of Jesus's hour can be heard (meaning decision m2); "le ha llegado la hora" is the everyday Spanish for a birth that is due. "Criatura", "bebé" and "ser humano" are already inclusive and need no setting; "el niño" and "un hombre" would suggest a male child (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: un être humain (L, B); un nouvel être humain (R)
decisions.reason: The word means a human being, not a male child (meaning decision m3). French "un homme" would now be read as "a man", so every level says "être humain"; this is the plain meaning, not a reader setting.

decisions.choice: huzuni (L, B), uchungu (R); binadamu (L, B), mtu mpya (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "huzuni", the noun of verses 20 and 22, so the woman's labour is seen as a picture of the disciples' grief (meaning note m1). Readable says "uchungu", the everyday word for the pains of childbirth. "Binadamu" (a human being) is inclusive, so no gender setting is needed (m3). Literal and Balanced keep "saa yake" (her hour) for the echo of Jesus's hour (m2); Readable says "wakati wake".

decisions.choice: đau buồn
decisions.reason: The Greek uses the same noun as for the disciples' sorrow in verses 20 and 22. "Đau buồn" holds both the pain of labour and grief, and keeps the echo of "buồn rầu" and "nỗi buồn" in the verses around it; Readable says plainly "đau đớn".

decisions.choice: 괴로움 (L, B); 아프다 (R) for lypē here
decisions.reason: The Greek uses the same word as the disciples' sorrow, but Korean 슬픔 does not fit the pain of labour; the link between the two is lost, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: "उसकी घड़ी" (L, B); "उसका समय" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "घड़ी", the word used for Jesus's hour, as the English keeps "hour"; Readable says "समय", the time for the child to be born (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "दर्द" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable does, Readable says "pain" for the woman in labour, which a young reader understands at once; Literal and Balanced keep "शोक", the disciples' word.

decisions.choice: "час" (L, B); "время" (R)
decisions.reason: Here the hour is the time for a child to be born (meaning decision m2), so Readable says "время", as the English says "time".

decisions.choice: "悲しみ" (L, B), "苦しむ" (R); "自分の時" (L, B), "その時" (R); "一人の人間" (L, B), "新しい人" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "悲しみ" for the same noun as in verses 20 and 22 (meaning decision m1), and "時" for her hour so that the echo of Jesus's hour can be heard (meaning decision m2); Readable says plainly what a young reader expects. The Greek word is the general one for a human being (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: 因着……的喜乐，她就不再记得那痛苦了 (L); 就因为……而满心喜乐，不再记得那痛苦了 (B)
decisions.reason: Chinese puts the cause before what it causes, so the joy of the birth comes before her forgetting the anguish, within the verse.

decisions.choice: "الحزن" (L), "تحزن" (B); "ألم" (R)
decisions.reason: The pain of labor is called by the same word as the disciples' sorrow (m1). Literal and Balanced keep "حزن" so the link to verse 20 is heard; Readable says "pain".

decisions.choice: "إنسانًا" (L, B), "إنسانًا جديدًا" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means a human being, a new person (m3), not a male child. "إنسان" already speaks of anyone.

source.text: καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν νῦν μὲν λύπην ἔχετε· πάλιν δὲ ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς, καὶ χαρήσεται ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία, καὶ τὴν χαρὰν ὑμῶν οὐδεὶς αἴρει ἀφ’ ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And you therefore now indeed sorrow have; again but I will see you, and will rejoice of you the heart, and the joy of you no one takes from you.

en.L: So you also now have sorrow; but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and your joy no one takes from you.
en.B: So it is with you: now you have sorrow, but I will see you again. Then your hearts will rejoice, and no one takes your joy away from you.
en.R: It is the same for you. You are sad now. But I will see you again. Then your hearts will be full of gladness. No one will ever take your joy away from you.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, por tanto, ahora {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} tristeza; pero de nuevo {{plural_you:los|os}} veré, y {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón se regocijará, y {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} gozo nadie {{plural_you:se lo|os lo}} quita.
es.B: Así pasa también con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: ahora {{plural_you:están|estáis}} tristes, pero {{plural_you:los|os}} veré otra vez. Entonces {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón se alegrará, y ese gozo nadie {{plural_you:se lo|os lo}} quita.
es.R: {{plural_you:A ustedes les pasa lo mismo|A vosotros os pasa lo mismo}}. Ahora {{plural_you:están|estáis}} tristes. Pero {{plural_you:los|os}} veré otra vez. Entonces {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón se llenará de alegría. Y nadie podrá nunca {{plural_you:quitarles|quitaros}} ese gozo.

fr.L: Vous aussi donc, maintenant, vous avez de la peine ; mais je vous verrai de nouveau, et votre cœur se réjouira, et votre joie, personne ne vous l’enlève.
fr.B: Il en est de même pour vous : maintenant vous êtes dans la peine, mais je vous reverrai. Alors vos cœurs se réjouiront, et votre joie, personne ne vous l’enlève.
fr.R: C’est pareil pour vous. Maintenant, vous êtes tristes. Mais je vous reverrai. Alors vos cœurs seront remplis de joie. Et personne ne pourra jamais vous enlever votre joie.

sw.L: Hivyo ninyi pia sasa mnayo huzuni; lakini tena nitawaona, na moyo wenu utafurahi, na furaha yenu hakuna mtu anayeiondoa kwenu.
sw.B: Ndivyo ilivyo kwenu: sasa mna huzuni, lakini nitawaona tena. Ndipo mioyo yenu itafurahi, na hakuna mtu anayewanyang'anya furaha yenu.
sw.R: Ndivyo ilivyo kwenu pia. Sasa mna huzuni. Lakini nitawaona tena. Ndipo mioyo yenu itajaa furaha. Hakuna mtu atakayewanyang'anya furaha yenu kamwe.

vi.L: Vậy các con cũng thế, bây giờ các con có nỗi buồn; nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lại thấy các con, và lòng các con sẽ vui mừng, và niềm vui của các con không ai lấy đi khỏi các con.
vi.B: Các con cũng vậy: bây giờ các con đang buồn rầu, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ gặp lại các con. Khi ấy lòng các con sẽ vui mừng, và không ai lấy mất niềm vui của các con được.
vi.R: Các con cũng thế. Bây giờ các con buồn. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ gặp lại các con. Lúc đó lòng các con sẽ tràn đầy vui mừng. Không ai có thể lấy mất niềm vui của các con.

ko.L: 그러므로 너희도 지금은 슬픔이 있다. 그러나 내가 너희를 다시 볼 것이고, 너희 마음이 기뻐할 것이며, 너희의 기쁨을 아무도 너희에게서 빼앗아 가지 못한다.
ko.B: 이처럼 너희도 지금은 슬픔에 잠겨 있다. 그러나 내가 너희를 다시 볼 것이다. 그때에 너희 마음이 기뻐할 것이고, 아무도 너희의 기쁨을 너희에게서 빼앗아 가지 못한다.
ko.R: 너희도 마찬가지다. 지금은 너희가 슬프다. 그러나 내가 너희를 다시 볼 것이다. 그러면 너희 마음이 기쁨으로 가득할 것이다. 아무도 그 기쁨을 너희에게서 빼앗아 가지 못할 것이다.

pt.L: Assim também vocês agora têm tristeza; mas eu os verei de novo, e o coração de vocês se alegrará, e a alegria de vocês ninguém tira de vocês.
pt.B: Assim também é com vocês: agora vocês sentem tristeza, mas eu os verei de novo. Então o coração de vocês se alegrará, e ninguém tira de vocês a alegria que vocês têm.
pt.R: Com vocês acontece o mesmo. Vocês estão tristes agora. Mas eu vou ver vocês de novo. Então o coração de vocês vai ficar cheio de alegria. Ninguém jamais vai tirar a alegria de vocês.

am.L: እናንተም ደግሞ አሁን ሐዘን አላችሁ፤ ነገር ግን እንደገና አያችኋለሁ፤ ልባችሁም ደስ ይለዋል፤ ደስታችሁንም ከእናንተ የሚወስድ ማንም የለም።
am.B: እናንተም እንዲሁ ናችሁ፤ አሁን ሐዘን አላችሁ፤ ነገር ግን እንደገና አያችኋለሁ። ያን ጊዜ ልባችሁ ደስ ይለዋል፤ ደስታችሁንም ከእናንተ የሚወስድ የለም።
am.R: እናንተም እንደዚሁ ናችሁ። አሁን አዝናችኋል። ነገር ግን እንደገና አያችኋለሁ። ያን ጊዜ ልባችሁ በደስታ ይሞላል። ደስታችሁን ከእናንተ የሚወስድ ማንም አይኖርም።

hi.L: वैसे ही तुम्हें भी अब तो शोक है; पर मैं तुम्हें फिर देखूँगा, और तुम्हारा मन आनंदित होगा, और तुम्हारा आनंद तुमसे कोई नहीं छीनता।
hi.B: तुम्हारे साथ भी ऐसा ही है: अभी तुम्हें शोक है, पर मैं तुम्हें फिर देखूँगा। तब तुम्हारे मन आनंदित होंगे, और तुम्हारा आनंद तुमसे कोई नहीं छीनता।
hi.R: तुम्हारे साथ भी यही बात है। अभी तुम दुखी हो। पर मैं तुम्हें फिर देखूँगा। तब तुम्हारे मन ख़ुशी से भर जाएँगे। तुम्हारा आनंद तुमसे कोई कभी नहीं छीन सकेगा।

ru.L: Так и вы теперь имеете печаль; но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} снова увижу вас, и возрадуется ваше сердце, и вашу радость никто не отнимает у вас.
ru.B: Так и с вами: сейчас у вас печаль, но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} снова увижу вас. Тогда ваши сердца возрадуются, и вашу радость никто у вас не отнимает.
ru.R: Так и с вами. Сейчас вам грустно. Но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} снова увижу вас. Тогда ваши сердца наполнятся радостью. Никто никогда не отнимет у вас вашей радости.

uk.L: Тож і ви тепер маєте смуток; але знову побачу вас, і зрадіє ваше серце, і вашої радості ніхто не забирає від вас.
uk.B: Так і з вами: тепер у вас смуток, але {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} знову побачу вас. Тоді зрадіють ваші серця, і ніхто не відбирає у вас вашої радості.
uk.R: Так і з вами. Зараз вам сумно. Але {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} знову побачу вас. Тоді ваші серця сповняться радістю. І ніхто ніколи не відбере у вас вашої радості.

ja.L: だから、あなたがたも今は悲しみを持っている。しかし、わたしは再びあなたがたを見る。そして、あなたがたの心は喜ぶ。そして、あなたがたの喜びをあなたがたから奪い去る者はだれもいない。
ja.B: あなたがたも同じである。今は悲しみがある。しかし、わたしは再びあなたがたに会う。そのとき、あなたがたの心は喜ぶ。その喜びを、だれもあなたがたから奪い去ることはない。
ja.R: あなたたちも同じだ。今は悲しんでいる。でも、わたしはまたあなたたちに会う。そのとき、あなたたちの心は喜びでいっぱいになる。その喜びを、あなたたちから奪い取る人はだれもいない。

id.L: Dan kalian juga sekarang berdukacita; tetapi {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan melihat kalian lagi, dan hati kalian akan bersukacita, dan tidak seorang pun mengambil sukacita kalian dari kalian.
id.B: Demikian juga kalian: sekarang kalian berdukacita, tetapi {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan melihat kalian lagi. Maka hati kalian akan bersukacita, dan tidak seorang pun dapat merampas sukacita kalian.
id.R: Begitu juga dengan kalian. Sekarang kalian sedih. Tetapi {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan melihat kalian lagi. Lalu hati kalian akan penuh sukacita. Tidak ada seorang pun yang akan mengambil sukacita kalian.

zh.L: 你们也是这样，现在有忧愁；但我会再看见你们，你们的心就要欢喜，你们的喜乐，没有人从你们身上夺走。
zh.B: 你们也是如此：现在你们有忧愁，但我会再见到你们。那时你们的心要欢喜，没有人能把你们的喜乐从你们身上夺走。
zh.R: 你们也是一样。你们现在很难过。但我会再见到你们。那时你们心里会充满喜悦。没有人能夺走你们的喜悦。

ar.L: فأنتم كذلك عندكم الآن حزن؛ لكنّي سأراكم ثانية، فيفرح قلبكم، وفرحكم لا ينتزعه منكم أحد.
ar.B: وهكذا أنتم: عندكم الآن حزن، لكنّي سأراكم مرّة أخرى. عندئذ تفرح قلوبكم، وما من أحد ينتزع فرحكم منكم.
ar.R: وكذلك أنتم. أنتم حزانى الآن. لكنّي سأراكم من جديد. وعندها تمتلئ قلوبكم بهجة. ولن يقدر أحد أن يأخذ فرحكم منكم أبدًا.

decisions.choice: I will see you again: Jesus will come to them risen, and their grief will turn to gladness
decisions.reason: In verse 16 the disciples are the ones who will see; here Jesus is: he will come and see them. This happens on the evening of the resurrection, when he stands among them and "the disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord" (20:19-20).

decisions.choice: your heart will rejoice: the words of Isaiah 66:14
decisions.reason: Isaiah 66 pictures Zion giving birth suddenly to a new people (66:7-9) and then says, "you will see, and your heart will rejoice" (66:14); the Greek translation of Isaiah has the same words as here. The labor picture of verse 21 and this promise come together from the same chapter. A reviewer should check the wording against the Greek of Isaiah.

decisions.choice: no one takes, present (αἴρει, SBLGNT)
alternatives: no one will take, future (some early manuscripts)
decisions.reason: Some early manuscripts have the future, "no one will take". The SBLGNT reads the present. The sense is nearly the same: the present states it as a settled fact. A footnote gives the other reading. A reviewer should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: no one takes your joy: a joy beyond anyone's reach, from then on
decisions.reason: The present states what will always be so: unlike their sorrow, which lasts only a little while, the joy of seeing him again cannot be taken from them by the world or anyone else. "Your heart" is singular, the heart of each and of all together.

decisions.choice: your hearts (B, R); no one takes ... away (B); No one will ever take ... away (R); full of gladness (R)
decisions.reason: English says "hearts" for the heart of each of several people. Balanced keeps the present "takes", which in English can state a lasting fact; Readable says "will ever take" to make the lasting fact plain (meaning decision m4). Readable says "full of gladness" for the verb "rejoice", keeping "joy" for the noun.

decisions.choice: su corazón, singular; nadie se lo quita (B); nadie podrá nunca quitarles (R); se llenará de alegría (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: Balanced keeps the present, which in Spanish can state a lasting fact; Readable says "nadie podrá nunca" to make the lasting fact plain (meaning decision m4). Spanish keeps "corazón" singular, as at 16:6. Readable says "alegría" for the verb, keeping "gozo" for the noun.

decisions.choice: "会う" (B, R); "見る" (L)
decisions.reason: "わたしはあなたがたを見る" sounds in Japanese like watching them; Jesus means that he will come to them risen and they will be together again (meaning decision m1), which "会う" says. Literal keeps "見る".

decisions.choice: "يفرح قلبكم" (L), "قلوبكم" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Your heart will rejoice echoes Isaiah 66:14 (m2). Literal keeps the singular "heart", as in 16:6; Balanced and Readable use the natural Arabic plural.

decisions.choice: present "ينتزعه" / "ينتزع"
decisions.reason: The text followed has the present "takes" (m3): a joy beyond anyone's reach from then on (m4). Readable says "no one will ever be able", which states the same certainty.

source.text: καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐμὲ οὐκ ἐρωτήσετε οὐδέν· ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἄν τι αἰτήσητε τὸν πατέρα δώσει ὑμῖν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου.

records.literal_gloss: And in that the day me not you will ask nothing; truly truly I say to you, if anything you ask the Father he will give to you in the name of me.

en.L: And in that day you will ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} nothing. Truly, truly I say to you, if you ask the Father anything, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give [it] to you in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.
en.B: On that day you will not ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} any questions. Truly, truly, I tell you, if you ask the Father for anything, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give it to you in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.
en.R: When that day comes, you will have no more questions to ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I tell you the truth: if you ask the Father for anything, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give it to you in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.

es.L: Y en aquel día a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:preguntarán|preguntaréis}} nada. En verdad, en verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: si algo {{plural_you:piden|pedís}} al Padre, {{plural_you:se lo|os lo}} dará en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre.

decisions.choice: two verbs for asking: "ask me nothing" (ἐρωτήσετε) means asking questions; "ask the Father" (αἰτήσητε) means asking for something
alternatives: both mean making requests: in that day they will not make requests of Jesus but of the Father
decisions.reason: The first verb is the one used in verse 19, where the disciples wanted to question Jesus, and in 16:5 and 16:30 for questioning him. The second is the ordinary verb for asking for something, the one used for prayer in 14:13-14, 15:7, 16 and verse 24. So Jesus most likely means: in that day you will have no more questions for me, and whatever you ask for, the Father will give. But the first verb can also mean a request (14:16; 16:26), and some take both halves to be about prayer.

decisions.choice: in that day: the time after Jesus is raised, when they see him again and the Spirit teaches them
decisions.reason: "That day" (14:20) is the time that begins when he comes to them again (verse 22). Then the Spirit will guide them into all the truth (16:13; 14:26), and Jesus will speak to them plainly about the Father (16:25); their puzzled questions of verses 17-19 will be answered.

decisions.choice: he will give you in my name (SBLGNT): "in my name" goes with the giving
alternatives: whatever you ask the Father in my name, he will give you (many manuscripts)
decisions.reason: In the SBLGNT, supported by some of the oldest manuscripts, among them Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus, "in my name" comes after "he will give you": the Father gives in Jesus's name. Many other manuscripts, among them Codex Alexandrinus and most later ones, put "in my name" before "he will give you", so that it is the asking that is done in his name, as in 14:13-14, 15:16 and verse 24. The difference is real but small, since both the asking and the giving rest on Jesus. A footnote gives the other reading. A reviewer should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: he will give in my name: the Father gives for Jesus's sake and through him
decisions.reason: A name stands for the person (see 14:13). The Father's gifts come to the disciples on account of Jesus and through him; the next verse adds that they are to ask in his name too. Asking and giving both rest on him.

decisions.choice: you will not ask me any questions (B); you will have no more questions to ask me (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that the first "ask" is about questions (meaning decision m1), so that it is not confused with asking the Father for things in the next sentence. Readable's "no more" connects the promise to the puzzled questions of verses 17-19. Literal keeps the same word "ask" for both verbs. "Truly, truly" is rendered as in verse 20.

decisions.choice: preguntar (to ask a question); pedir (to ask for something)
decisions.reason: Spanish has two verbs that match the two Greek verbs (meaning decision m1), so every level keeps them apart: "preguntar" for questions to Jesus, "pedir" for asking the Father. Balanced and Readable say "ninguna pregunta" and "ya no ... preguntas", linking the promise to the questions of verses 17-19.

decisions.choice: interroger, poser des questions (asking Jesus); demander (asking the Father)
decisions.reason: Greek uses two verbs here (meaning decision m1): one for asking questions, one for asking for something. French "demander" alone would blur them, so the first is "interroger" (L) or "poser des questions" (B, R) and the second "demander".

decisions.choice: kuuliza (ask a question); kuomba (ask for something)
decisions.reason: Swahili has two verbs where the Greek has two (meaning note m1), so even Literal keeps them apart: "hamtaniuliza" for questions, "mkimwomba" for requests to the Father, as in 14:13-14 and verse 24.

decisions.choice: hỏi (ask a question) and xin (ask for)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has two everyday verbs that match the two Greek verbs exactly, so the distinction the meaning decision describes shows at every level without explanation.

decisions.choice: 묻다 for "ask me" (questions); 구하다 for "ask the Father" (requests)
decisions.reason: Korean has two verbs that match the two Greek ones, so the difference the meaning note describes stays visible.

decisions.choice: perguntar / fazer perguntas for the first verb; pedir for the second
decisions.reason: Portuguese has two verbs that match the two Greek ones (meaning decision m1): "perguntar" for asking a question and "pedir" for asking for something, so even Literal keeps them apart without extra words.

decisions.choice: "አትጠይቁኝም" (you will ask me nothing, asking questions); "ብትለምኑት" (if you ask him for anything)
decisions.reason: The Greek uses two verbs here (meaning decision m1): one for asking questions, one for asking for something. Amharic has the same pair, "መጠየቅ" and "መለመን", so the difference shows without a note; "መለመን" is used for the second verb throughout 14:13-16:26.

decisions.choice: "पूछोगे" for asking Jesus; "माँगोगे" for asking the Father
decisions.reason: The Greek has two verbs here: one for asking questions, one for asking for something (meaning decision m1). Hindi has the same pair, "पूछना" and "माँगना", so every level keeps them apart.

decisions.choice: "спросить" for asking a question; "попросить" for asking for something
decisions.reason: The Greek has two verbs (meaning decision m1); Russian keeps them apart at every level with "спрашивать" and "просить", without the supplied words the English needs.

decisions.choice: "питати" for the first verb, "просити" for the second
decisions.reason: Ukrainian has two verbs that match the two Greek ones (meaning decision m1): "питати" is to ask a question, "просити" to ask for something, so the distinction shows without explanation.

decisions.choice: "尋ねる" / "聞く" for asking questions; "求める" for asking for something
decisions.reason: Two Greek verbs for asking stand side by side (meaning decision m1). Japanese keeps them apart: "尋ねる" (L, B) and "聞く" (R) for questions, as in 16:19, and "求める" for asking the Father, as in 15:7, 15:16 and 16:24.

decisions.choice: "问" (ask me nothing); "求" (ask the Father)
decisions.reason: Two verbs for asking (meaning decision m1): asking questions of Jesus, and asking the Father for something; Chinese has a word for each.

decisions.choice: "因我的名……赐给"
decisions.reason: In the SBLGNT "in my name" goes with the Father's giving (meaning decision m3); "因我的名" says the Father gives for Jesus's sake, kept apart from "奉我的名" for the disciples' asking.

decisions.choice: "تسألوني" for asking questions, "طلبتم" for asking for something
decisions.reason: The Greek has two verbs: one for asking questions, one for asking for something (m1). Arabic "سأل عن" and "طلب" keep them apart.

decisions.choice: "سيعطيكم إيّاه باسمي"
decisions.reason: In the text followed, "in my name" goes with the giving (m3): the Father gives for Jesus's sake and through him (m4).

records.literal_gloss: Until now not you asked nothing in the name of me; ask and you will receive, so that the joy of you may be having been made full.

en.L: Until now you have asked nothing in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name; ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be made full.
en.B: So far you have asked for nothing in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy will be complete.
en.R: Up to now you have never asked for anything in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. Keep asking, and you will receive, so that your joy will be full.
